chip.description: Mitsubishi M37450 microcontroller with on-die program ROM, used as the I/O and coin/input controller of later Namco System 2 boards.
chip.notes: src/mame/namco/namco68.cpp in MAME 0.288 (device full name "Namco C68 I/O") wraps an m37450_device with an internal ROM region. Filed mcu under taxonomy TB2. MAME instantiates the m37450 core as a separate device inside this one, so a machine can list both for a single package.
